assets.label: Neumorphic baseplate landscape
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Transparent isometric landscape/map baseplate for web composition
Primary request: Use the reference crop only as style and composition guidance. Generate a brand-new standalone transparent WebP-ready asset: an elegant isometric/neumorphic miniature Greater Toronto Area map baseplate made of warm off-white paper/clay material, with subtle embossed roads, soft relief grid lines, small rounded trees, tiny low-rise model blocks, canals, shoreline, and pale blue water along the lower edge. Preserve the soft premium Fairlend landing-page lighting, warm shadows, shallow depth, and refined 3D diorama feel. Keep the asset clean and usable behind live UI: no text labels, no route line, no red pins, no UI cards, no icons, no buttons, no house hero object, no skyline/CN Tower, no brand marks. Isolated subject on a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background for alpha removal, with generous padding and no cast shadow onto the background.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later alpha removal; do not use #00ff00 in the subject.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.negative_prompt: Do not include screenshot pixels, page chrome, Fairlend logo, navigation, CTAs, typography, cards, red route path, red markers, city labels, house, goal card, Toronto skyline, CN Tower, people, watermark, or border.
